description: Both Gods share attributable Miracle→Devotion rules: substantial actual Heal and productive Efficiency help recipients, smaller witnessed effects, local Rain prayer fulfillment, and modest tangible crop blessings. 40+ ordinary preaching remains protected.

semantics.childUpbringing: Repeated household contact creates own religious affiliation. Two 80+ parents can gradually nurture children up to Devotion 55, but never inherit Zealot/Devout bands outright.
semantics.preaching: Priesthood is an independent, measurable social multiplier. Recent local Priest preaching adds a separate 24% weekly baseline recruitment opportunity (scaled by receptivity), over ordinary family/social exposure, and an additional 1.8× consolidation rate. Disabled Priest ablations retain direct prayer and ordinary social spread. Physical five-cell contacts and a Spread Oracle raise recruitment through true Priest visits; these cannot directly displace a 40+ believer.
semantics.devotion: Priest interactions alone cannot displace an established 40+ rival believer. Low-devotion foreign followers gradually doubt their old affiliation in bounded steps under real local Priest preaching, and may freely choose the new religion once below 20; no forced blanket conversion and no competing AI God simulation yet.
semantics.migration: Faith follows actual people and households; exchange is abstract nearby social contact, not teleportation or divine broadcast.
semantics.reproducibility: Seven-day low-rate pulses use a separate seeded religion PRNG, preserving economic PRNG inputs.
semantics.competition: The first-pass low-devotion foreign affiliation path models a rival's personal state only; complete rival God power/Temple/AI and reciprocal missionary pressure remain deferred.
semantics.miracleEvidence: Direct Heal requires real health restored >=7, gain ~17–25 Devotion with credible attribution; Efficiency credits after beneficial actual work, +14 direct. Witnesses gain only +2/+3. Opposing 40+ commitment may be weakened by credible divine evidence but not ordinary sermons. Unaffiliated/weakly aligned residents retain short-lived God-specific impressions, then make their own weekly adoption decisions.
semantics.rainEvidence: Only a geographically matched own-God Rain responding to a real active prayer with improved local field moisture and actual local food work can credit Devotion; the AI has equivalent prayers.
semantics.cropEvidence: Harvest credits small witness effect when it measurably improves existing standing crop. Ripening credits small witness effect only after additional physical crop growth exceeds the configured minimum.
semantics.spreadOracle: In addition to making willing adult believers preach more often, real heard local sermons receive a distinct bounded recruit chance; both Gods see the complete sermon interval before counters reset.
semantics.compatibility: Profile ID remains v0.1 to avoid disrupting old saves; new optional values normalize with safe defaults. UI treats faith responses as actual person state changes, not direct player commands.
